title.zh: 卷三十六 唐書12: 明宗本紀二
title.en: Volume 36 Book of Later Tang 12: Mingzong Annals 2
title.raw: 卷三十六 唐書12: 明宗本紀二 Volume 36 Book of Later Tang 12: Mingzong Annals 2

sentences.zh: 天成元年夏四月丙午，帝自興聖宮赴西宮，文武百僚縞素於位，帝服斬衰，親奉攢，塗設奠，哭盡哀，乃於柩前即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, bingwu of Tiancheng 1, the Emperor went from Xingsheng Palace to the Western Palace; civil and military officials in white stood at their posts; the Emperor wore the deepest mourning, personally bore the coffin bier, applied plaster and set offerings, wept to the utmost, and then before the bier assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fourth month of Tiancheng 1, Mingzong left Xingsheng Palace for the Western Palace; officials in white stood at their posts while he wore deepest mourning, bore the bier, set offerings, wept his fill, and took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 百官易吉服班於位，帝御袞冕受冊訖，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: The hundred officials changed to auspicious dress and took ranks at their posts; the Emperor in imperial robes and cap received the investiture scroll; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials changed to court dress and lined up; Mingzong in imperial robes received the investiture scroll, and the court congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群官縞素赴西宮臨。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the mass of officials in white went to the Western Palace for viewing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei officials in white went to the Western Palace to view the bier.

sentences.zh: 以樞密使安重誨為檢校司空，守左領軍大將軍，依前充樞密使。

translations.literal: Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Grand Preceptor, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Grand Preceptor and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.

sentences.zh: 宰臣豆盧革等三上表請聽政，從之。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Dou Luge and others three times memorialized asking that he hold court; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luge and the chief ministers three times asked Mingzong to hold court; he agreed.

sentences.zh: 遣使往諸道及淮南告哀。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to the circuits and Huainan to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys announced Zhuangzong's death to the circuits and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝始聽政於中興殿。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Emperor first held court at Zhongxing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Mingzong first held court at Zhongxing Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，西南面副招討使、工部尚書任圜率步騎二萬六千人入見。

translations.literal: On renzi, Southwest Deputy Pacification Commissioner and Minister of Works Ren Yuan led twenty-six thousand foot and horse to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Ren Yuan, Southwest deputy pacification commissioner and Minister of Works, led twenty-six thousand foot and horse to audience.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Emperor at Wenhua Hall received court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Mingzong received court at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 製改同光四年為天成元年，大赦天下。

translations.literal: A decree changed Tongguang 4 to Tiancheng 1 and granted a great amnesty to all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: A decree renamed Tongguang 4 as Tiancheng 1 and amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 後宮內職量留一百人，內官三十人，教坊一百人，鷹坊二十人，禦廚五十人，其餘任從所適。

translations.literal: Inner-palace posts were limited to one hundred persons, inner eunuchs thirty, Music Office one hundred, Falcon Office twenty, Imperial Kitchen fifty; the rest were free to go where they wished.
translations.idiomatic: The inner palace was cut to one hundred posts, thirty eunuchs, one hundred musicians, twenty falconers, and fifty kitchen staff; the rest could leave as they chose.

sentences.zh: 諸司使務有名無實者並停。

translations.literal: Commissioner posts in the various offices that had names but no reality were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Nominal commissioner posts in the ministries were abolished.

sentences.zh: 分遣諸軍就食近畿，以減饋送之勞。

translations.literal: Armies were dispatched in groups to forage near the capital to reduce the labor of supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: Armies were sent to forage near the capital to ease supply lines.

sentences.zh: 秋夏稅子，每鬥先有省耗一升，今後隻納正數，其省耗宜停。

translations.literal: For autumn-summer tax grain, each dou had formerly included one sheng of official shrinkage; hereafter only the full measure was to be paid, and shrinkage was to stop.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn-summer grain tax had taken one sheng per dou as shrinkage; hereafter only the full measure was due and shrinkage ended.

sentences.zh: 天下節度、防禦使，除正、至、端午、降誕四節量事進奉，達情而已，自於州府圓融，不得科斂百姓。

translations.literal: Circuit and defense commissioners throughout the realm, aside from the four festivals of New Year, solstice, Dragon Boat, and birthday, might present limited ceremonial tribute to show sentiment only, from their own prefectural funds, and might not levy the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit and defense commissioners could send only modest festival gifts at New Year, solstice, Dragon Boat, and birthday from their own funds, not levy the people.

sentences.zh: 其刺史雖遇四節，不在貢奉。

translations.literal: Their prefectural governors, even on the four festivals, were not subject to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects were exempt from festival tribute even on those four days.

sentences.zh: 諸州雜稅，宜定合稅物色名目，不得邀難商旅。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous taxes in the prefectures should fix the categories of taxable goods and might not harass travelers and merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures had to list taxable goods clearly and stop harassing merchants.

sentences.zh: 租庸司先將係省錢物，與人回圖，宜令盡底收納，以塞幸門雲。

translations.literal: The Rent and Corvée Office had advanced tied provincial funds for trade with others; they were ordered to collect them fully to block loopholes.
translations.idiomatic: The Rent and Corvée Office was ordered to recover all provincial funds it had lent for private trade and close the loophole.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，渤海國王大諲譔遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yimao, Bohai King Da Yinse sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Bohai's King Da Yinse sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 是月，北京副留守、知留守事張憲賜死，以其失守故也。

translations.literal: That month, Beiping deputy military commissioner and acting military commissioner Zhang Xian was granted death for having lost his post.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Xian, Beiping deputy commissioner, was executed for losing his post.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，帝不視朝，臨於西宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day bingchen: the Emperor did not hold court and attended at the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month Mingzong skipped court and mourned at the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 宰相豆盧革進位左僕射，韋說進位門下侍郎兼戶部尚書、監修國史，並依舊平章事。

translations.literal: Chancellor Dou Luge was advanced to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Wei Shuo was advanced to Gate Chamberlain concurrent Minister of Revenue and director of the National History, both continuing as Grand Councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luge became Left Vice Director; Wei Shuo became Gate Chamberlain, Revenue minister, and historiographer, both keeping Grand Councillor rank.

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使、檢校太傅朱守殷加同平章事，充河南尹，判六軍諸衛事；

translations.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor Zhu Shouyin was added Grand Councillor, made Henan prefect, and assigned the six armies and guards;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shouyin of Yan, acting grand preceptor, became Grand Councillor, Henan prefect, and commander of the six armies and guards;

sentences.zh: 滄州節度使、檢校太傅安元信加同平章事，移鎮徐州；

translations.literal: Cangzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor An Yuanxin was added Grand Councillor and transferred to Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: An Yuanxin of Cang became Grand Councillor and moved to Xu;

sentences.zh: 邠州節度使、檢校太保毛璋加同平章事。

translations.literal: Binzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian Mao Zhang was added Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Zhang of Bin, acting grand guardian, became Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客鄭玨為中書侍郎兼刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事；

translations.literal: Crown Prince Mentor Zheng Jue was made Gate Chamberlain concurrent Minister of Punishments and Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Jue, crown prince mentor, became Gate Chamberlain, Punishments minister, and Grand Councillor;

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書任圜為中書侍郎兼工部尚書、同中書門下平章事、判三司。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Ren Yuan was made Gate Chamberlain concurrent Minister of Works, Grand Councillor, and overseer of the three offices.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yuan became Gate Chamberlain, Works minister, Grand Councillor, and overseer of the three offices.

sentences.zh: 徐州節度使李紹真、貝州刺史李紹英、齊州防禦使李紹虔、河陽節度使李紹奇、洺州刺史李紹能等上言，前朝寵賜姓名，今乞還舊。

translations.literal: Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen, Beizhou prefect Li Shaoying, Qizhou defense commissioner Li Shaogian, Heyang military commissioner Li Shaoqi, Mingzhou prefect Li Shaoneng, and others memorialized that the former dynasty had bestowed surnames and given names and they now begged to restore the old.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaozhen of Xu, Li Shaoying of Bei, Li Shaogian of Qi, Li Shaoqi of Heyang, Li Shaoneng of Ming, and others asked to drop the Li surname Zhuangzong had given them.

sentences.zh: 內李紹虔上言：「臣本姓王，後移杜氏，蒙前朝賜今姓名，乞復本姓。

translations.literal: Among them Li Shaogian memorialized: "My original surname was Wang; I later took the Du surname; the former dynasty bestowed my present surname and given name—I beg to restore my original surname.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaogian added, "I was born Wang, then Du; Zhuangzong gave me Li Shaogian—I ask to be Wang again.

sentences.zh: 」詔並可之。

translations.literal: " An edict approved all.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong approved all.

sentences.zh: 李紹真復曰霍彥威，李紹英復曰房知溫，李紹虔復曰王晏球，李紹奇復曰夏魯奇，李紹能復曰米君立。

translations.literal: Li Shaozhen was restored as Huo Yanwei, Li Shaoying as Fang Zhiwen, Li Shaogian as Wang Yanqiu, Li Shaoqi as Xia Luqi, Li Shaoneng as Mi Junli.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaozhen became Huo Yanwei, Li Shaoying Fang Zhiwen, Li Shaogian Wang Yanqiu, Li Shaoqi Xia Luqi, Li Shaoneng Mi Junli.

sentences.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事符習加兼侍中，徐州節度使、檢校太傅霍彥威加兼侍中，移鎮鄆州。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Councillor Fu Xi was additionally made Palace Attendant; Xuzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor Huo Yanwei was additionally made Palace Attendant and transferred to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xi of Qing, grand councillor, gained Palace Attendant; Huo Yanwei of Xu gained Palace Attendant and moved to Yan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，初詔文武百僚正衙常參外，五日一度內殿起居。

translations.literal: On dingsi an initial edict ordered that aside from the hundred civil and military officials' regular main-hall attendance, every five days they should attend inner palace levee.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Mingzong ordered officials to attend the main hall as usual and also hold inner levee every five days.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：載天成元年五月三日敕：今後宰臣文武百官，除常朝外，每五日一度入內起居。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records a Tiancheng 1, fifth month, third day edict: hereafter chancellors and civil and military officials, aside from regular court, should enter the inner palace for levee every five days.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 cites a Tiancheng 1 edict of the third of the fifth month: aside from regular court, chancellors and officials should attend inner levee every five days.

sentences.zh: 其中書非時有急切公事請開延英，不在此限。）〉

translations.literal: When the Secretariat had urgent business not on schedule, it might request Yanying Hall audience—this was not limited.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Urgent Secretariat business could still open Yanying Hall and was exempt.)〉

sentences.zh: 麟州奏，指揮使張延寵作亂，焚剽市民，已殺戮訖。

translations.literal: Lin Prefecture reported that commandant Zhang Yanchong had rebelled, burned and plundered the townspeople, and had already been killed.
translations.idiomatic: Lin reported commandant Zhang Yanchong had rebelled, looted the city, and been executed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，河陽節度使夏魯奇加檢校太傅，以貝州刺史房知溫為兗州節度使，以齊州防禦使王晏球為宋州節度使，以洺州刺史米君立為邢州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Heyang military commissioner Xia Luqi was made acting Grand Preceptor; Beizhou prefect Fang Zhiwen was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Qizhou defense commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made Songzhou military commissioner; Mingzhou prefect Mi Junli was made Xingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Xia Luqi of Heyang became acting grand preceptor; Fang Zhiwen took Yan; Wang Yanqiu took Song; Mi Junli took Xing.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜文武百官各一馬一驢。

translations.literal: On jiwei, each civil and military official was given one horse and one donkey.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei every official received one horse and one donkey.

sentences.zh: 西都知府張篯進魏王繼岌打球馬七十二匹。

translations.literal: Western Capital prefect Zhang Qian presented seventy-two polo horses of Prince of Wei Jiji.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qian, Western Capital prefect, presented seventy-two of Prince Jiji's polo ponies.

sentences.zh: 北京馬步都指揮使李從溫奏，準詔誅宦官。

translations.literal: Beiping horse-and-foot commander Li Congwen reported that eunuchs were being executed per edict.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congwen, Beiping horse-and-foot commander, reported eunuchs were being killed on edict.

sentences.zh: 初，莊宗遇內難，宦者數百人竄匿山谷，落發為僧，奔至太原七十餘人，至是盡誅於都亭驛。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhuangzong met inner turmoil, several hundred eunuchs hid in mountain valleys, shaved their heads as monks, and fled to Taiyuan—more than seventy—and now all were executed at Duting Post.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhuangzong's fall several hundred eunuchs had fled as monks; more than seventy reached Taiyuan and were now executed at Duting Post.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔華州放散西川宮人各歸骨肉。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered Huazhou to release Western Shu palace women to their kin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Mingzong ordered Huazhou to send Shu palace women home to their families.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前相州刺史、北京左右廂都指揮使安金全為安北都護、振武節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: On renxu, former Xiangzhou prefect and Beiping left-and-right wing commander An Jinquan was made Pacifier of the North, Zhenwu military commissioner, and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu An Jinquan, former Xiang prefect and Beiping wing commander, became Pacifier of the North, Zhenwu commissioner, and Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，前西都留守、京兆尹張筠加檢校太傅，充山南西道節度使；

translations.literal: On jiazi, former Western Capital military commissioner and Jingzhao prefect Zhang Yun was made acting Grand Preceptor and Shanxi West Circuit military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Yun, former Western Capital commissioner and Jingzhao prefect, became acting grand preceptor and Shanxi West commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以夔州節度使李紹文為遂州節度使；

translations.literal: Kuizhou military commissioner Li Shaowen was made Suizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaowen of Kui was made Suizhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以前鄧州留後戴思遠為洋州節度使。

translations.literal: former Dengzhou acting military commissioner Dai Siyuan was made Yangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: former Deng acting commissioner Dai Siyuan was made Yang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以金吾將軍張實為金州防禦使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Golden Crow general Zhang Shi was made Jinzhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhang Shi became Jin defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以金紫光祿大夫、檢校司空趙在禮為滑州節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Golden-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture and acting Grand Preceptor Zhao Zaili was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhao Zaili, golden-glitter grand master and acting grand preceptor, was named Huazhou commissioner and acting grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 製下，在禮以軍情不順為辭，不之任。

translations.literal: When the decree was issued, Zaili declined on grounds that army sentiment was unfavorable and did not take the post.
translations.idiomatic: Zaili refused the post, citing unrest in the army.

sentences.zh: 以許州留後陶玘為鄧州留後，以諸道馬步副都指揮使安審通為齊州防禦使。

translations.literal: Xuzhou acting military commissioner Tao Qi was made Dengzhou acting military commissioner; circuit horse-and-foot deputy overall commander An Shentong was made Qizhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Qi of Xu became Deng acting commissioner; An Shentong, deputy overall horse-and-foot commander, became Qi defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以權知北京軍府事、汾州刺史符彥超為晉州留後，以前陳州刺史劉伸殷為陝州留後。

translations.literal: On gengwu, acting Beiping military commissioner and Fenzhou prefect Fu Yanchao was made Jinzhou acting military commissioner; former Chenzhou prefect Liu Shenyin was made Shanzhou acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Fu Yanchao, acting Beiping commissioner and Fen prefect, became Jin acting commissioner; Liu Shenyin, former Chen prefect, became Shan acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以前磁州刺史劉彥琮為同州留後。

translations.literal: On guiyou, former Cizhou prefect Liu Yancong was made Tongzhou acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Liu Yancong, former Ci prefect, became Tong acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，福州節度使、檢校太傅王延翰加檢校太尉、同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Fuzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor Wang Yanhan was made acting Grand Guardian and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wang Yanhan of Fu, acting grand preceptor, became acting grand guardian and Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，翰林學士、戶部侍郎、知制誥馮道，翰林學士、中書舍人趙鳳，俱以本官充端明殿學士。

translations.literal: On yihai, Hanlin academician, Revenue vice minister, and edict drafter Feng Dao and Hanlin academician and Secretariat drafting officer Zhao Feng were both made Duanming Hall academicians at their present ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Feng Dao and Zhao Feng, Hanlin academicians, became Duanming Hall academicians at rank.

sentences.zh: 端明之職，自此始也。

translations.literal: The post of Duanming began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Duanming post began here.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：明宗初登位，四方書奏，多令樞密使安重誨讀之，不曉文義。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records: when Mingzong first took the throne, memorials from the four directions were mostly read by Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui, who did not understand literary meaning.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 says when Mingzong first reigned, An Chonghui read most frontier memorials but lacked literary training.

sentences.zh: 於是孔循獻議，因唐室侍讀之號，即創端明學士之名，命馮道等為之。）〉

translations.literal: Thereupon Kong Xun offered a plan: following Tang's lecture-reader title, they created the name Duanming academician and appointed Feng Dao and others.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Kong Xun then proposed reviving Tang's lecture-reader title as Duanming academician and named Feng Dao and others.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔：「故西道行營都招討製置等使、守侍中、監修國史、兼樞密使郭崇韜宜許歸葬，其世業田宅並還與骨肉。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict said: "The late Western Circuit campaign overall pacification and disposition commissioner, Palace Attendant, historiographer, and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Guo Chongtao should be permitted burial; his hereditary estates and dwellings should all be returned to his kin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict said Guo Chongtao, late western-campaign commander and palace attendant, might be buried and his estates returned to his family.

sentences.zh: 故萬州司戶朱友謙可復護國軍節度使、守太師、兼尚書令、河中尹、西平王，所有田宅財產，並還與骨肉。

translations.literal: The late Wanzhou registrar Zhu Youqian may be restored as Huguo military commissioner, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Heyang prefect, and Prince of Xiping; all estates and property should be returned to his kin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Youqian, late Wan registrar, was restored as Huguo commissioner, grand preceptor, Heyang prefect, and Prince of Xiping, with estates returned to his kin.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，西都衙內指揮使張篯進納偽蜀主王衍犀玉帶各二條、馬一百五十匹。

translations.literal: " On dingchou, Western Capital inner commandant Zhang Qian presented two rhinoceros and jade belts each and one hundred fifty horses of the false Shu ruler Wang Yan.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingchou Zhang Qian, Western Capital inner commandant, presented two rhinoceros-and-jade belts and one hundred fifty horses from the false Shu ruler Wang Yan.

sentences.zh: 初，莊宗遣中官向延嗣就長安之殺王衍也，旋屬蕭牆之禍，延嗣藏竄，不知所之，而衍之資裝妓樂並為篯所有，復懼事泄，故聊有此獻。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhuangzong had sent the inner eunuch Xiang Yansi to Chang'an to kill Wang Yan; soon the palace turmoil followed, Yansi hid and his whereabouts were unknown, while Yan's goods, equipage, and entertainers all fell to Qian's possession; fearing exposure, he therefore made this brief presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong had sent the eunuch Xiang Yansi to Chang'an to kill Wang Yan; after the palace coup Yansi vanished and Yan's goods and entertainers passed to Zhang Qian, who now offered a slice of the hoard for fear of exposure.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以樞密使安重誨兼領襄州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was additionally made Xiangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin An Chonghui was also named Xiangzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 製下，重誨之黨謂重誨曰：「襄州地控要津，不可乏帥，無宜兼領。

translations.literal: When the decree was issued, Chonghui's faction said to Chonghui: "Xiangzhou controls a strategic ford and cannot lack a commander—it is not fitting to hold concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When the decree issued, his allies told An Chonghui Xiangzhou was too strategic to hold with the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 」重誨即自陳退，許之。

translations.literal: " Chonghui at once memorialized to withdraw; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " He asked to step down and Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 以左金吾大將軍張遵誨為西京副留守、知留守事。

translations.literal: Left Golden Crow general Zhang Zunhui was made Western Capital deputy military commissioner and acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zunhui, left Golden Crow general, became Western Capital deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以衛尉卿李懌為中書舍人，充翰林學士。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Court of the Imperial Stud director Li Yin was made Secretariat drafting officer and Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Yin, Court of the Imperial Stud director, became drafting officer and Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以前蔚州刺史張溫為振武留後，以左右廂突陣指揮使康義誠為汾州刺史，以左右廂馬軍都指揮使索自通為忻州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu, former Yunzhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commanders Kang Yicheng and Suo Zitong were made Fenzhou and Xinzhou prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhang Wen took Zhenwu; Kang Yicheng and Suo Zitong became Fen and Xin prefects.

sentences.zh: 尚父、吳越國王錢鏐遣使進金器五百兩、銀萬兩，綾萬匹謝恩，賜玉冊、金印。

translations.literal: Imperial Father-in-law and King of Wuyue Qian Liu sent envoys presenting five hundred liang of gold vessels, ten thousand liang of silver, and ten thousand bolts of silk to thank for favor; a jade book and gold seal were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu of Wuyue sent five hundred liang of gold vessels, ten thousand liang of silver, and ten thousand bolts of silk in thanks; Mingzong granted a jade book and gold seal.

sentences.zh: 初，同光季年，鏐上疏密求玉冊、金印，郭崇韜進議以為不可，而樞密承旨段徊受其重賂，讚成其事，莊宗即允其請，至是故有貢謝。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the late Tongguang years Liu had memorialized in secret asking for a jade book and gold seal; Guo Chongtao had memorialized that it should not be done, but Privy Council edict-drafter Duan Hui took his heavy bribes and urged the matter through; Zhuangzong then granted the request—hence this tribute of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Tongguang Qian Liu had secretly asked for a jade book and seal; Guo Chongtao opposed it, but Duan Hui of the Privy Council took heavy bribes and pushed it through; Zhuangzong granted it—hence the thank-offering.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幽州節度使、檢校太保李紹斌加檢校太傅、同平章事，復姓名為趙德鈞。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Youzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian Li Shaobin was made acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Councillor and his name was restored as Zhao Dejun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Li Shaobin of You, acting grand guardian, became acting grand preceptor and Grand Councillor and was restored as Zhao Dejun.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔百官朔望入閣，賜廊下食。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict ordered the hundred officials on the crescent days to enter the hall and granted corridor meals.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Mingzong ordered officials on crescent days to enter the hall and restored corridor meals.

sentences.zh: 自亂離已前，常參官每日朝退賜食於廊下，謂之「廊餐」。

translations.literal: Before the turmoil, regular-attendance officials daily after court were granted food in the corridor, called "corridor meals.
translations.idiomatic: Before the wars, regular-attendance officials had received daily corridor meals after court.

sentences.zh: 乾符之後，百司經費不足，無每日之賜，至是遇入閣即賜之。

translations.literal: " After Qianfu, the hundred offices lacked funds and there was no daily grant; now on entering the hall it was granted again.
translations.idiomatic: " After Qianfu the ministries could not afford daily grants; now hall days brought the meal back.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：明宗初即位，命百官五日一起居，李琪以為非故事，請罷之。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records: when Mingzong first took the throne he ordered the hundred officials to attend inner levee every five days; Li Qi held it was not precedent and asked that it be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 says Mingzong's five-day inner levee drew Li Qi's protest as nonprecedent.

sentences.zh: 惟每月朔望日合入閣賜食。

translations.literal: Only on the first and fifteenth of each month should they enter the hall and receive food.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi asked that only the first and fifteenth bring hall entry and meals.

sentences.zh: 至是宣旨，朔望入閣外，仍五日一起居，遂為定式。）〉

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict was proclaimed: aside from crescent-day hall entry, the five-day inner levee still stood, and it became the fixed rule.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong kept crescent-day meals and the five-day inner levee anyway, and that became fixed practice.)〉

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，前襄州節度使李紹珙起復，依前襄州節度使，仍復本姓名曰劉訓。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuzi: former Xiangzhou military commissioner Li Shaogong was recalled to service and continued as Xiangzhou military commissioner, his name also restored as Liu Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the sixth month Li Shaogong was recalled to Xiangzhou and restored as Liu Xun.

sentences.zh: 以皇子河中留後從珂為河中節度使，百僚表賀。

translations.literal: The Prince's Hedong acting military commissioner Congke was made Hedong military commissioner; the hundred officials memorialized congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congke, Hedong acting commissioner, became Hedong commissioner; the court congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 以翰林承旨、兵部尚書、知制誥盧質為檢校司空，充同州節度使。

translations.literal: Hanlin edict-drafter, Minister of War, and edict drafter Lu Zhi was made acting Grand Preceptor and Tongzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting grand preceptor and Tong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以使部尚書、判太常卿事李琪為御史大夫；

translations.literal: On jichou, Envoy Minister and acting Director of Ceremonies Li Qi was made Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Qi, envoy minister and acting Ceremonies director, became censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 以禮部尚書崔協為太常卿、判吏部尚書銓事；

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Cui Xie was made Director of Ceremonies and acting Director of Personnel selection;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xie of Rites became Ceremonies director and acting Personnel director;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞崔居儉為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: censor-in-chief Cui Jujian was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jujian became War vice minister;

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客蕭頃為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Mentor Xiao Xiang was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Xiang, crown prince mentor, became Rites minister.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「請以九月九日皇帝降誕日為應聖節，休假三日。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "We ask that the ninth day of the ninth month, the Emperor's birthday, be made the Yingsheng Festival with three days' leave.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked that the ninth of the ninth, Mingzong's birthday, become the Yingsheng Festival with three days off.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 故忠武軍節度使、檢校太師、兼尚書令、齊王張全義贈太師，以前尚書右丞崔沂為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: The late Zhongwu military commissioner, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi was posthumously made Grand Preceptor; former Right Assistant Minister of the Secretariat Cui Yi was made Left Assistant Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Quanyi, late Zhongwu commissioner and Prince of Qi, was posthumously made grand preceptor; Cui Yi became left assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 丙申，新州留後張庭裕、雲州留後高行珪並正授本軍節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Xinzhou acting military commissioner Zhang Tingyu and Yunzhou acting military commissioner Gao Xinggui were both fully appointed military commissioners of their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Tingyu of Xin and Gao Xinggui of Yun received full commissionerships.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔曰：「四夷來王，歷代故事，前後各因強弱，撫製互有典儀。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict said: "The four barbarians come to court—an institution of every age; before and after, each according to strength and weakness, the handling and control had their canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict said foreign rulers had always come to court, and each age had its rites scaled to their power.

sentences.zh: 大蕃須示於威容，即於正衙引對；

translations.literal: Great barbarians required display of majesty and were led to audience in the main hall;
translations.idiomatic: Great powers deserved full ceremony in the main hall;

sentences.zh: 小蕃但推於恩澤，仍於便殿撫懷。

translations.literal: small barbarians were only to be treated with grace and still received in the convenient hall with reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: lesser ones received grace in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 憲府奏論，禮院詳酌，皆征故實，咸有明文。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized and the Rites Office examined in detail; all drew on precedent and all had clear text.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate and Rites Office had reviewed precedent and found clear rules for both.

sentences.zh: 正衙威容，未可全廢；

translations.literal: Main-hall majesty could not be wholly abolished;
translations.idiomatic: Main-hall ceremony could not be dropped entirely;

sentences.zh: 內殿恩澤，且可常行。

translations.literal: inner-hall grace might still be carried out regularly.
translations.idiomatic: side-hall reception should remain routine.

sentences.zh: 若遇大蕃入朝，即準舊儀，於正殿排比鋪陳立仗，百官排班，於正門引入對見。

translations.literal: When great barbarians came to court, follow the old rites: in the main hall arrange ranks and standing guards, the hundred officials in formation, and at the main gate introduce them for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Great embassies would follow the old rites: guards and officials in formation at the main gate and audience in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 」時百僚入閣班退後，卻引對朝貢蕃客，御史大夫李琪奏論之，下禮院檢討，而降是命焉。

translations.literal: " At the time, after the hundred officials' hall ranks had withdrawn, tributary foreign guests were still introduced for audience; Censor-in-Chief Li Qi memorialized on it; it was sent to the Rites Office for review, and this decree was then issued.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Qi had protested that after hall audience the court still received tributary envoys in the side hall; Rites reviewed the case and Mingzong issued this order.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，樞密使安重誨加檢校太保，行兵部尚書事如故。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Grand Guardian and continued to act as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu An Chonghui became acting grand guardian while keeping acting War minister.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事劉嶽為兵部侍郎，以太子右庶子王權為戶部侍郎，以太子左庶子任讚為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Mentor Liu Yue was made Vice Minister of War; Crown Prince Right Vice Mentor Wang Quan was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Crown Prince Left Vice Mentor Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yue, crown prince mentor, became War vice minister; Wang Quan, right vice mentor, Revenue vice minister; Ren Zan, left vice mentor, Works vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，荊南節度使、檢校太師、兼尚書令、南平王高季興加守太尉、兼尚書令，澤潞節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事孔加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Prince of Nanping Gao Jixing was made acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Zelu military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, co-equal Chief Councilor Kong was also made concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Gao Jixing of Jingnan—acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Prince of Nanping—became acting Grand Marshal with the directorate; Zelu commissioner Kong, acting Grand Marshal and co-equal councilor, also gained concurrent Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 汴州屯駐控鶴指揮使張諫等謀叛伏誅，以樞密使孔循權知汴州軍州事。

translations.literal: At Bianzhou the garrisoned Crane-Control commanders Zhang Jian and others plotted rebellion and were executed upon exposure; Privy Council commissioner Kong Xun was appointed acting Bianzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At Bian the garrisoned Crane-Control commanders Zhang Jian and others plotted revolt and were executed; Privy Council commissioner Kong Xun was made acting Bian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，樞密使孔循加檢校太保、守秘書監，依前充使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Privy Council commissioner Kong Xun was made acting Grand Guardian, acting Master of Writing, and continued as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Kong Xun became acting Grand Guardian and Master of Writing while keeping the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 己巳，秘書少監姚顗為左散騎常侍，以太子左諭德陸崇為右散騎常侍，以兵部郎中蕭希甫為左諫議大夫，前幽州節度判官呂夢奇為右諫議大夫，以鄴都副留守孫嶽為潁州團練使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yao Hui was made Left Regular Attendant; the crown prince's Left Mentor Lu Chong was made Right Regular Attendant; Bureau of Military Affairs director Xiao Xifu was made Left Remonstrator; former Youzhou military commissioner's aide Lü Mengqi was made Right Remonstrator; Yedu deputy regent Sun Yue was made Yingzhou training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Yao Hui became Left Regular Attendant; crown prince mentor Lu Chong became Right Regular Attendant; Xiao Xifu of Military Affairs became Left Remonstrator; Lü Mengqi, former Youzhou aide, became Right Remonstrator; Sun Yue, Yedu deputy regent, became Ying training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「古者酌禮以製名，懼廢於物；

translations.literal: An edict said: "In antiquity ritual was weighed to fix names, lest things be abandoned; what is hard to violate yet easy to avoid was prized for convenience in the age.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Antiquity weighed ritual to fix names lest usage be lost; what was hard to breach yet easy to sidestep was valued for the times.

sentences.zh: 取其難犯而易避，貴便於時。

translations.literal: Moreover the two names "Zheng" and "Zai" already had precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the taboo names Zheng and Zai already had precedent.

sentences.zh: 況『征 』『在』二名，抑有前例。

translations.literal: When the Literary Emperor Taizong ascended the throne he did not change his old style; at the time there was a minister Yu Shinan and an office Minbu—no bending away was heard of, only consecutive calling was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong took the throne he kept his old style; minister Yu Shinan and the Minbu office stood without evasion—only double calling was barred.

sentences.zh: 以太宗文皇帝自登寶位，不改舊稱，時即臣有世南，官有民部，靡聞曲避，止禁連呼。

translations.literal: I, petty in person, rest on men above—I only follow the sage model and dare not be self-important.
translations.idiomatic: I am slight in person and rest on others above—I follow the sage model only and dare not exalt myself.

sentences.zh: 朕猥以眇躬，托於人上，止遵聖範，非敢自尊。

translations.literal: Wherever the two characters appear in documents, so long as they are not called in succession, evasion is not required.
translations.idiomatic: In documents the two characters need not be avoided unless spoken in succession.

sentences.zh: 應文書內所有二字，但不連稱，不得回避。

translations.literal: If a subject's name should not share characters with ruler and kin, let him change it as he wishes.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects who wish not to share characters with ruler and kin may change their names as they please.

sentences.zh: 如是臣下之名，不欲與君親同字者，任自改更。

translations.literal: 」On dingwei the Secretariat and Chief Councilor memorialized: "The capital's former hidden-dragon residence—we ask that it be named the Palace of Highest Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingwei the Secretariat memorialized: "The capital's former hidden-dragon residence should be named the Palace of Highest Virtue.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，中書門下奏：「京城潛龍舊宅，望以至德宮為名。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xiazhou military commissioner, Grand Mentor of the Palace with the same authority as the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Shuofang Li Renfu was granted an additional thousand households in fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Renfu of Xia—Grand Mentor equal to the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Shuofang—gained a thousand more households in fief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，夏州節度使、開府儀同三司、檢校太師、兼中書令、朔方王李仁福加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xiazhou military commissioner, Grand Mentor of the Palace with the same authority as the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Shuofang Li Renfu was granted an additional thousand households in fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Renfu of Xia—Grand Mentor equal to the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Shuofang—gained a thousand more households in fief.

sentences.zh: 以延州留後高允韜為延州節度使，以利州節度觀察留後張敬詢為利州節度使。

translations.literal: Yanzhou acting commissioner Gao Yuntao was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Lizhou military and surveillance acting commissioner Zhang Jingxun was made Lizhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuntao became Yan commissioner; Zhang Jingxun became Li commissioner.

sentences.zh: 劍南西川節度副大使、知節度使事孟知祥加檢校太傅、兼侍中，劍南東川節度副大使、知節度事董璋加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Southern Shu western circuit military vice commissioner and acting military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant; southern Shu eastern circuit military vice commissioner and acting military commissioner Dong Zhang was made acting Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang of western Shu became acting Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant; Dong Zhang of eastern Shu became acting Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鳳翔節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令李從嚴加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On renzi, Fengxiang military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, concurrent Secretariat Director Li Congyan was made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Congyan of Fengxiang—acting Grand Marshal and Secretariat director—became acting Grand Preceptor with the directorate.

sentences.zh: 汴州知州孔循奏，召集謀亂指揮使趙虔已下三千人並族誅訖。

translations.literal: Bianzhou acting prefect Kong Xun memorialized that the rebellious commanders gathered, Zhao Xu and more than three thousand men below him, had all been executed clan and all.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Xun, acting Bian prefect, reported that the mutinous commanders led by Zhao Xu—three thousand men and below—had been wiped out to the clan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以晉州留後符彥超為北京留守，以鎮州副使王建立為鎮州留後，以右龍武統軍安崇阮為晉州留後。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jin acting commissioner Fu Yanchao was made Beijing regent; Zhenzhou deputy Wang Jianli was made Zhen acting commissioner; Right Dragon Martial commander An Chongruan was made Jin acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Fu Yanchao became Beijing regent; Wang Jianli became Zhen acting commissioner; An Chongruan became Jin acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使高季興上言「夔、忠、萬三州，舊是當道屬郡，先被西川侵據，今乞卻割隸本管。

translations.literal: Jingnan military commissioner Gao Jixing memorialized: "The three prefectures Kui, Zhong, and Wan were formerly subordinate to this circuit and were first seized by western Shu; we now ask that they be cut off and returned to this jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jixing of Jingnan memorialized: "Kui, Zhong, and Wan were once under this circuit until western Shu seized them; we ask that they be returned to this jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 」詔可之。

translations.literal: 」An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 其夔州，偽蜀先曾建節，宜依舊除刺史。

translations.literal: As for Kui, the false Shu had once established a commission there—it was ordered that a prefect be appointed as before.
translations.idiomatic: For Kui, where false Shu had once set a commission, a prefect was to be appointed as before.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒考異》引《十國紀年荊南史》：天成元年二月壬辰，請忠、夔、萬州及雲安監隸本道，莊宗許之。

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian Collated Variants》 cites the 《Annals of Jingnan in the Records of the Ten Kingdoms》: in the second month of Tiancheng 1, on renchen, he asked for Zhong, Kui, Wan, and the Yun'an salt office under this circuit; Zhuangzong approved.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian Collated Variants》 cites the 《Annals of Jingnan in the Records of the Ten Kingdoms》: in the second month of Tiancheng 1, on renchen, he sought Zhong, Kui, Wan, and the Yun'an salt office; Zhuangzong approved.

sentences.zh: 詔命未下，莊宗遇弑。

translations.literal: Before the edict could issue, Zhuangzong was assassinated.
translations.idiomatic: Before the edict arrived, Zhuangzong was killed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，王表求三州，明宗許之。）〉

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renchen, Gao memorialized for the three prefectures and Mingzong approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, Gao asked again for the three prefectures and Mingzong approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯朔，以太原舊宅為積慶宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yimao first day: the old Taiyuan residence was made the Accumulated Celebration Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the first of the seventh month, the old Taiyuan residence became the Accumulated Celebration Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，契丹、渤海國俱遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Khitan and Bohai both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Khitan and Bohai both sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔割韓城、郃陽兩縣屬同州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict cut off Hancheng and Heyang counties and attached them to Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict detached Hancheng and Heyang from their circuit and placed them under Tong.

sentences.zh: 誅滑州左右崇牙及長劍等軍士數百人，夷其族，作亂故也。

translations.literal: Several hundred soldiers of the Left and Right Honored Tusk and Long Sword armies at Hua were executed and their clans exterminated—for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred soldiers of Hua's Honored Tusk and Long Sword units were killed and their clans wiped out for mutiny.

sentences.zh: 其都校於可洪等相次到闕，亦斬於都市。

translations.literal: Their commanders Yu Kehong and others reached the capital in succession and were also beheaded in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Their commanders, led by Yu Kehong, reached the capital in turn and were beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以偽蜀守司空、門下侍郎、平章事、晉國公王諧為檢校司空、守陵州刺史，以虢州刺史石潭為耀州團練使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, false Shu's acting Minister of Works, Gate Chief Councilor, co-equal Chief Councilor, Duke of Jin Wang Yan was made acting Minister of Works and Ling prefect; Guo prefect Shi Tan was made Yao training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wang Yan of false Shu—acting Works minister, gate councilor, co-equal councilor, and Duke of Jin—became acting Works minister and Ling prefect; Shi Tan of Guo became Yao training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔：「諸道節度、刺史、文武將吏，舊進月旦起居表，今後除節度、留後、團練、防禦使，惟正、至進賀表，其四孟月並且止絕。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict: "Military commissioners, prefects, and civil and military officers of all circuits who formerly submitted monthly first-day attendance memorials—hereafter only military commissioners, acting commissioners, training commissioners, and defense commissioners shall submit congratulatory memorials at the solstices and equinoxes; the four seasonal months shall cease entirely.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict: "Circuit commissioners and prefects who once sent monthly first-day attendance tables shall hereafter send solstice and equinox congratulations only for commissioners, acting commissioners, training commissioners, and defense commissioners; the four seasonal months are abolished.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，中書門下上言：「宣旨令進納新授諸道判官、州縣官官告敕牒，隻應宣賜。

translations.literal: 」On jiaxu, the Secretariat and Chief Councilor memorialized: "By imperial instruction, newly appointed circuit aides and prefectural officials are to present commission patents and edict copies—they should be granted by edict alone.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiaxu the Secretariat said: "By instruction, new circuit aides and county officials should receive patents by edict alone, not by presentation.

sentences.zh: 準往例，除將相外，並不賜官告，即因梁氏起例，凡宣授官，並特恩賜。

translations.literal: By former precedent, except for generals and chancellors, commission patents were not granted; since Liang's example, every appointed office received special grants.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly only generals and chancellors received patents; since Liang, every appointment brought a special grant.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，自兩使判官令錄在京除授者，即於內殿謝恩，便辭赴任，不更進納官告，判司主簿，不合更許朝對。

translations.literal: We have deliberated: for aides of the two bureaus and registry officials appointed in the capital, let them thank the throne in the inner hall and depart without presenting patents; chief clerks of bureaus should not again be granted audience.
translations.idiomatic: We propose: capital-appointed aides of the two bureaus and registry clerks should thank the throne in the inner hall and leave without patents; bureau chiefs should not again receive audience.

sentences.zh: 敕下後，望準舊例處分。

translations.literal: After the edict issues, let it be handled per old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: After promulgation, handle it by old precedent.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，莊宗皇帝梓宮發引，帝縗服臨送於樓前。

translations.literal: On yihai, Emperor Zhuangzong's coffin was escorted forth; the Emperor in hemp mourning attended the send-off before the tower.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhuangzong's coffin was moved; the Emperor in hemp mourning saw it off before the tower.

sentences.zh: 是日，葬莊宗於雍陵。

translations.literal: That day Zhuangzong was buried at Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhuangzong was buried at Yongling.

sentences.zh: 鎮州留後王建立奏，涿州刺史劉殷肇不受代，謀叛，昨發兵收掩，擒劉殷肇及其黨一十三人，見折足勘詰。

translations.literal: Zhen acting commissioner Wang Jianli memorialized that Zhuo prefect Liu Yinzhao would not accept replacement and plotted rebellion; troops were sent yesterday to seize him; Liu Yinzhao and thirteen of his party were captured and are now being interrogated with broken legs.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianli of Zhen reported that Zhuo prefect Liu Yinzhao refused transfer and rebelled; troops seized him yesterday; Liu and thirteen followers were captured and are under interrogation with legs broken.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以比部郎中、知制誥楊凝式為給事中，充史館修撰、判館事；

translations.literal: On jimao, Revenue Bureau director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yang Ningshi became Drafting Attendant, History Office reviser, and acting director;

sentences.zh: 以偽蜀吏部尚書楊玢為給事中，充集賢殿學士、判院事。

translations.literal: false Shu's Minister of Personnel Yang Bin was made Drafting Attendant, charged as Academician of the Hall for Collecting Worthies and acting director.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Bin of false Shu became Drafting Attendant, Academician of the Collecting Worthies Hall, and acting director.

sentences.zh: 升應州為彰德軍節度，仍以興唐軍為寰州，隸彰德軍。

translations.literal: Yingzhou was promoted to Zhangde circuit command; Xingtang Army was still made Huanzhou under Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was raised to Zhangde circuit; Xingtang Army became Huan under Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 宰相豆盧革貶辰州刺史，韋說貶漵州刺史，仍令所在馳驛發遣，為諫議大夫蕭希甫疏奏故也。

translations.literal: Chancellor Dou Lu Ge was demoted to Chen prefect and Wei Shuo to Xi prefect; both were ordered dispatched post-haste from their posts—for Remonstrator Xiao Xifu's memorial of accusation.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Lu Ge was demoted to Chen prefect and Wei Shuo to Xi—for Remonstrator Xiao Xifu's indictment—and both were ordered sent off at once.

sentences.zh: 製略曰：「革則縱田客以殺人，說則侵鄰家而奪井，選元亨之上第，改王參之本名。

translations.literal: An edict in summary said: "Ge let tenant farmers kill men; Shuo seized a neighbor's well; they chose Yuan Heng for top rank and changed Wang Can's original name.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summarized: "Ge let tenants kill; Shuo seized a neighbor's well; they ranked Yuan Heng first and changed Wang Can's name.

sentences.zh: 或主掌三司，委元隨之務局；

translations.literal: One held the Three Bureaus and entrusted affairs to Yuan Sui;
translations.idiomatic: One ran the Three Bureaus and handed affairs to Yuan Sui;

sentences.zh: 或陶鎔百里，受長吏之桑田。

translations.literal: another smelted a hundred li and took a senior official's mulberry fields.
translations.idiomatic: another worked a hundred li and took a senior official's mulberry land.

sentences.zh: 鹹屈塞於平人，互阿私於愛子。

translations.literal: Both wronged commoners and favored their own in mutual private dealings.
translations.idiomatic: Both wronged commoners and showed favor to kin.

sentences.zh: 任官匪當，黷貨無厭，謀人之國若斯，致主之方安在！

translations.literal: Their appointments were unfit, their bribes insatiable—to scheme against the state thus, how can the ruler's way stand!
translations.idiomatic: Unfit appointments, insatiable bribes—to scheme on the state thus—where is the ruler's way!

sentences.zh: 既迷理亂，又昧卷舒。

translations.literal: They were blind to order and chaos alike and knew neither restraint nor release.
translations.idiomatic: Blind to order and chaos, knowing neither restraint nor release.

sentences.zh: 而府司案牘爰來，諫署奏章疊至，備彰醜跡，深汙明庭。

translations.literal: Yet office dossiers kept coming and remonstrance memorials piled up—their ugly tracks fully shown, deeply staining the bright court.
translations.idiomatic: Office dossiers and remonstrance memorials piled up—their crimes plain, the bright court deeply stained.

sentences.zh: 是宜約以三章，投之四裔。

translations.literal: They should be bound by the three punishments and cast to the four borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: They should face the three punishments and be cast to the four borders.

sentences.zh: 其河南府文案及蕭希甫論疏，並宜宣示百僚。

translations.literal: The Henan prefecture documents and Xiao Xifu's memorial should all be displayed to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's documents and Xiao Xifu's memorial should be shown to all officials.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，賜蕭希甫衣段二十匹、銀器五十兩，賞疏革、說之罪也。

translations.literal: 」On gengchen, Xiao Xifu was granted twenty bolts of silk and fifty taels of silverware—to reward his exposing Ge and Shuo's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengchen Xiao Xifu received twenty bolts of silk and fifty taels of silver—for exposing Ge and Shuo.

sentences.zh: 宰相鄭玨、任圜再見安重誨，求解革、說，請不復追行後命，又三上表救解，俱留中不報。

translations.literal: Chancellors Zheng Jue and Ren Yuan again saw An Chonghui to seek release for Ge and Shuo, asking that the later orders not be pursued; they also thrice submitted memorials to save them—all held at court without reply.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Jue and Ren Yuan again saw An Chonghui to free Ge and Shuo and stop the later orders; they memorialized three times—all held without reply.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以捧聖嚴衛左廂馬步軍都指揮使李從璋領饒州刺史，充大內皇城使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Support-the-Sacred Strict Guard Left Wing horse-and-foot commander Li Congzhang was made Rao prefect and charged as inner-palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Congzhang, Left Wing commander of the Support-the-Sacred Guard, became Rao prefect and inner-palace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏：「條製，檢校官各納尚書省禮錢，舊例太師、太尉納四十千，後減落至二十千；

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Chief Councilor memorialized: "By regulation, acting officials each pay ceremonial fees to the Ministry of Rites; the old rate for Grand Preceptor and Grand Marshal was forty thousand, later reduced to twenty thousand;
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "By rule acting officials pay Ministry of Rites fees; Grand Preceptor and Grand Marshal once paid forty thousand, later twenty;

sentences.zh: 太傅、太保元納三十千，減至十五千；

translations.literal: Grand Tutor and Grand Guardian originally thirty thousand, reduced to fifteen thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor and Grand Guardian once thirty thousand, later fifteen;

sentences.zh: 司徒、司空元納二十千，減至一十千；

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Minister of War originally twenty thousand, reduced to ten thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Works and War ministers once twenty thousand, later ten;

sentences.zh: 僕射、尚書元納一十五千，減至七千；

translations.literal: Vice Director and Director originally fifteen thousand, reduced to seven thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors and directors once fifteen thousand, later seven;

sentences.zh: 員外、郎中元納一十千，今納三千四百者。

translations.literal: Outside-office and bureau directors originally ten thousand, now three thousand four hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Outside-office and bureau directors once ten thousand, now three thousand four hundred.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「會府華資，皇朝寵秩，凡沾新命，各納禮錢。

translations.literal: 」An edict said: "The capital's splendid offices and the dynasty's favored ranks—whoever receives new appointment pays ceremonial money.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict said: "Capital rank and dynastic favor—every new appointment pays ceremonial fees.

sentences.zh: 爰自近年，多隳舊制，遂致紀綱之地，遽成廢墜之司。

translations.literal: In recent years the old system has largely collapsed, so that the place of discipline has become a neglected office.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the old system collapsed and the discipline office was neglected.

sentences.zh: 況累條流，就從減省，方當提舉，宜振規繩。

translations.literal: Moreover the accumulated articles have been reduced; it is time to raise and restore the rules.
translations.idiomatic: Fees have been cut repeatedly; it is time to restore the rules.

sentences.zh: 但緣其間，翊衛勳庸，藩宣將佐，自軍功而遷陟，示恩澤以獎酬，須議從權，不在其例。

translations.literal: But among them, meritorious guards and frontier commissioners who rose through military merit and were rewarded with grace should be discussed with flexible exception and are not in this category.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious guards and frontier commissioners raised by military merit are excepted.

sentences.zh: 其餘自不帶平章事節度使及防禦、團練、刺史、使府副使、行軍已下，三司職掌監務官，州縣官，凡關此例，並可征納。

translations.literal: All others—from military commissioners without co-equal councilor rank and defense, training, and prefectural commissioners, deputy commissioners, campaign deputies and below, Three Bureaus supervisors, and prefectural officials—whoever falls under this rule may be collected.
translations.idiomatic: All others—commissioners without councilor rank, defense, training, and prefectural posts, deputies, campaign staff, Three Bureaus supervisors, and county officials—must pay.

sentences.zh: 其檢校官自員外郎至僕射，隻初轉一任納錢，若不改呼，不在征納。

translations.literal: Acting officials from outside-office director to Vice Director pay only on first transfer to a new title; if the title is unchanged, collection does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Acting officials from outside-office director through Vice Director pay only on first promotion; unchanged titles are exempt.

sentences.zh: 仍委尚書省部司專切檢舉，置曆逐月具數申中書門下。」

translations.literal: Let the Ministry departments strictly investigate, keep a monthly register, and report totals each month to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry departments shall investigate, keep monthly registers, and report to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔辰州刺史豆盧革可責授費州司戶參軍，漵州刺史韋說可責授夷州司戶參軍，皆員外置同正員，仍令馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict: Chen prefect Dou Lu Ge may be demoted to Feizhou Registrar in Exile; Xi prefect Wei Shuo may be demoted to Yizhou Registrar in Exile—both extra-status equal to regular appointees—and both ordered dispatched post-haste.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Dou Lu Ge of Chen was demoted to Fei registrar in exile and Wei Shuo of Xi to Yi registrar—extra-status equal to regular rank—and both sent off at once.

sentences.zh: 甲申，又詔曰：「責授費州司戶參軍豆盧革、夷州司戶參軍韋說等，自居台輔，累換歲華，負先皇倚注之恩，失大國燮調之理。

translations.literal: On jiashen, another edict: "Demoted Feizhou Registrar Dou Lu Ge and Yizhou Registrar Wei Shuo, having held the councilor's bench and changed years many times, betrayed the late emperor's trust and failed the great state's harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen another edict: "Dou Lu Ge of Fei and Wei Shuo of Yi, long at the councilor's bench, betrayed the late emperor's trust and failed the state's harmony.

sentences.zh: 朕自登宸極，常委鈞衡，略無謙遜之辭，但縱貪饕之意。

translations.literal: Since I ascended the throne I have constantly entrusted the scales to them, yet there was scarcely modest speech—only greedy intent was indulged.
translations.idiomatic: Since my accession I entrusted them with power, yet they showed no modesty—only greed.

sentences.zh: 除官受賂，樹黨徇私，每虧敬於朕前，徒自尊於人上。

translations.literal: Selling offices for bribes, forming factions for private ends—they were ever lacking in respect before me yet arrogant above others.
translations.idiomatic: They sold offices, formed factions, lacked respect before me, and were arrogant toward others.

sentences.zh: 道路之喧騰不已，諫臣之條疏頗多，罪狀顯彰，典刑斯舉，合從極法，以塞群情。

translations.literal: The roads clamored without end; remonstrators' memorials were many; their crimes were plain and the code was invoked—they should receive the extreme penalty to satisfy public feeling.
translations.idiomatic: The roads clamored; remonstrance piled up; crimes were plain—the extreme penalty should satisfy the crowd.

sentences.zh: 尚緣臨御之初，含弘是務，特軫墜泉之慮，爰施解網之仁，曲示優恩，俯寬後命。

translations.literal: Yet at the start of rule forbearance was the task; specially moved by concern for the fallen spring, grace of loosening the net was shown—favor bent low and the later order was lenient.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the start of rule forbearance mattered; moved by concern for the fallen, the net was loosened and the later order made lenient.

sentences.zh: 革可陵州長流百姓，說可合州長流百姓，仍委逐處長知所在。

translations.literal: Ge may be long exiled to Ling as commoner; Shuo may be long exiled to He as commoner; both are to be overseen wherever they are.
translations.idiomatic: Ge was long exiled to Ling as commoner; Shuo to He as commoner; local authorities were to watch them.

sentences.zh: 同州長春宮判官、朝請大夫、檢校尚書、禮部郎中、賜紫金魚袋豆盧升，將仕郎、守尚書屯田員外郎、崇文館學士、賜緋魚袋韋濤等，各因權勢，驟列班行，無才業以可稱，竊寵榮而斯久。

translations.literal: Tongzhou Ever-Spring Palace aide, Court Gentleman for Prolonging Grace, acting Director of the Secretariat, Ministry of Rites director with purple-gold fish Dou Lu Sheng; Preparation Gentleman, acting Ministry of Revenue outside-office director, Academician of the Chongwen Hall with scarlet fish Wei Tao and others—each through power suddenly entered the ranks; no talent to speak of, yet stolen glory long endured.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Lu Sheng, Tong Ever-Spring aide and scarlet-fish Academician; Wei Tao, Preparation Gentleman and Chongwen academician—they rose by power without talent yet held rank long.

sentences.zh: 比行貶謫，以塞尤違。

translations.literal: This demotion was to stop the worst offenses.
translations.idiomatic: This demotion stopped the worst offenses.

sentences.zh: 朕以纂襲之初，含容是務，父既寬於後命，子宜示於特恩，並停見任。

translations.literal: At the start of succession forbearance was the task; the fathers having received lenient later orders, the sons should receive special grace—all current posts are suspended.
translations.idiomatic: At succession forbearance mattered; fathers having lenient orders, sons received grace—all current posts suspended.

sentences.zh: 」升、濤即革、說之子也。

translations.literal: 」Sheng and Tao were Ge and Shuo's sons.
translations.idiomatic: 」Sheng and Tao were Ge and Shuo's sons.
